title: Chapter 3 — AI practice quiz 5
instructions: Short original AI-authored practice; not an official or teacher paper. Self-mark using the guidance after submission.
description: Three original questions with self-marking guidance.

questions.text: State a benefit of solid-state storage in portable devices.

answer.text: It has no moving parts and is resistant to mechanical shock.

questions.text: What is the function of primary memory?

answer.text: It holds instructions and data currently needed by the processor.

questions.text: Why might an output device need a buffer?

answer.text: It temporarily stores data while the slower device processes it.
